            ∀ {r₁ : ℕ},
              (∀ (j : Option τ), r j ≤ r₁) →
                ∀ {q : Option τ → ℕ} {B : ℝ},
                  ThetaOption214Broader.Θ B q r ≤
                    2 *
                      (Finset.Icc 1 (r none + 1)).sup' ⋯ fun l ↦
                        ThetaOption214Broader.lem6Φ q r (ThetaOption214Broader.lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l +
                            √(ThetaOption214Broader.lem6Φ q r (ThetaOption214Broader.lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l)
                                l) +
                          √δ
